manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Grows in-between detail for recorded commons frames by bounded interpolation, keeping only candidates consistent with signed neighbor frames.
manifest.name: @kody-w/ez_sharpen_agent

action.description: sharpen = polish one frame vs its neighbors; grow = sharpen every interior frame of a recording (recursive frame grower); compete = run MULTIPLE engines that compete to add non-conflicting detail, judged + self-improved over passes (glitches shrink, winners merge); demo = self-test. Default demo.

candidates.description: Optional host-LLM-proposed enhancement records for cur: [{id, v:[numbers], kind, note}]. Each is filtered by the dream catcher.

cur.description: For sharpen: the frame to polish (same shape). Its signed entities are immutable.

frames.description: For grow: an inline ordered list of frames [{ts, entities:{...}}] to grow.

next.description: For sharpen: the next frame (same shape).

passes.description: For compete: how many judge-and-improve rounds to run (engines nudge toward the winner each pass). Default 3.

prev.description: For sharpen: the previous frame {ts, entities:{id:{v:[..], kind, signed}}}.

recording.description: For grow: path to a recording dir (frameNN.state.json + manifest.json from CommonsShow record) to grow instead of inline frames.

subdivide.description: For grow: synthesize this many interpolated sub-frames between each pair (recursive growth). Default 0 (none).

tolerance.description: Slack allowed beyond the neighbor bound before a candidate is judged contradictory. Default 0 (strict).
